info.name: Interview Transcript Evaluator
info.description: Evaluate interview transcripts against job descriptions. Provides per-answer feedback, overall candidate summary, and interviewer feedback.

item.name: Evaluate with job_id only (fetch JD from Chroma)

request.description: Fetch job description from Chroma by job_id. No job_description override.
Use pre-structured Q&A format. Preferred when you have question-answer pairs already.
Use transcript as list of {speaker, text} turns. Speaker: 'interviewer' or 'candidate'.

body.raw:
{
  "job_id": "job_123",
  "uid": "candidate_456",
  "job_description": "Senior Software Engineer - Backend

Requirements:
- 5+ years Python/Java
- SQL and database design",
  "transcript": "Interviewer: Tell me about a time you led a technical project.

Candidate: At my last company I led a team of 4 engineers to migrate our monolith to microservices. We used Python and Django.

Interviewer: How do you approach database design for high-traffic systems?

Candidate: I focus on indexing strategies first. We use PostgreSQL and read replicas.",
  "include_interviewer_feedback": true
}

request.description: Use raw string with 'Interviewer:' and 'Candidate:' (or Q: and A:) prefixes.
Skip interviewer feedback section. Faster response.
